session: This round was opened by the SESSION as M0-a-02's HARDENING ROUND S4 (J237 (2): the M0 hardening phase's fix rounds, batched per owning item; J238: M0 is the bedrock — the default for an M0 row is FIX with an exact precaution and a pin; J567: the bar is an independent closing check's PASS on the evidence), on the rows J757 routes to this item — the re-triage's entry 'M0-a-02' (docs/validation/hardening-retriage-2026-11-09/plan.json, class COMPOUNDS, ratified at J722) less its Q76 line, which R10 moved to leg 2: Q79 (the `shape` role, RL4; with Q74's last remainder), a-02:N-s3c-2, a-02:N-s3c-1, and the raise's declared shift. Each 'failing line' below is one such row — an open queue row routed to this item (docs/M0-FIX-QUEUE.md) or a row the item's latest closing check wrote into its notes file; its evidence names the SOURCE you MUST read whole before fixing; the fix shape and the pin are the re-triage's reading, binding unless the source or the code shows it wrong — then say so in your notes and do what the finding needs. THE RULES OF A HARDENING ROUND: (1) inside the item's owns and nowhere else — a row that needs another item's file is REPORTED, not built; (2) every row gets a PIN (a test that is red without the fix; your mutant table shows each pin killing its mutant) unless the row is comment-only or asks for a choices row — then the text is the deliverable; (3) BEHAVIOUR: a hardening fix may move output where a defect is fixed — a DECLARED shift, stated in your choices row with the before and after (digests and goldens re-recorded in the same round, named), never silent; where a row offers alternatives, take the one the design's text supports and say which; a change of an operation's or stage's CONTRACT (its design-level behaviour, a record or file format, an exported API) is NOT yours — report it as a note for the session's ruling and leave the row at REPORTED; (4) J264 / N-58: the refusal census of the item's registered families before and after the round, never rising (a row whose fix makes a lawful input succeed lowers it and says so); (5) API frozen (J263 Q1): no export of a folder index or the barrel added, removed or renamed unless a row explicitly asks for one — then the index change is the row's and stated; message texts pinned verbatim where a row changes one (J263 Q6); (6) the gates, NEAR and RELATED@1000 as the brief above says, at W=1; (7) the item's notes file gains a section 'Hardening round S4' with the row-by-row outcome (fixed / pinned / reported, each with its evidence and mutant), and the round's choices row names every row it closes. The CLOSING CHECKER confirms every row's outcome with its own evidence (re-reading the source note or queue row), re-kills every pin's mutant, re-measures the refusal census, and judges new findings by the blocker rule only; a row left REPORTED with a stated contract reason is not a failing line. THIS IS LEG 1 OF A MERGED ROUND OF TWO LEGS (the MERGED-ROUND RULE, J443): M0-a-02 S4 → M0-a-06 S10, in that order, on ONE tree and ONE branch, no reset between, each leg with its own build, closing check, LANDED line and record; leg 2 launches only when leg 1 returned ok with check.verdict pass (it builds on it). THE ROUND WAS SPECCED WITH A THIRD LEG, on M0-a-05 (the write of the `shape` rows at the chain's commit, its register kind and the oracles): the session SPLIT IT OFF (J797) to run as its own round after BOTH this round and the router round have landed — wherever this entry, the rulings file or a file they cite says 'leg 3' or 'M0-a-05 S15', read 'the later round on M0-a-05'; nothing of it is built, planted or pinned here beyond what the lines below say. Reds labelled THE STRENGTH or THE HEAD are not the round's. WHAT GOES TO THE QUEUE AND IS NOT THIS ROUND'S (docs/validation/rq2-spec-2026-11-11/rulings-final.md, 'What goes to the queue'): (i) F8 — a STRETCH of a chain that ENDS at a two-key own point, or a rekey CUT there, clears that point's split flag (§2.2 rule 3 (b) compares whole row sets), so once the chain's rest goes the point stays on the other chain for ever — a queue row for a RULING on rule 3 (b)'s comparison; the round's design sentence and pins are scoped to a chain removed WHOLE and to a stretch's INTERIOR, and no pin asserts the other chain's restoration after a stretch end or a cut; (ii) the reverse order (C inserted first, A along it later, then C removed: the point stays on A) — N-13's canonical-form class, named in the design sentence's scope; (iii) three coincident chains with the base removed first (rows and flag stay) — a notes row; (iv) R17 (a): decode refusing a row whose role's `since` exceeds its chunk's version — M0-a-15; R17 (b): whether a cache written under an older registry version may be used at all — M1's loader; (v) R12: the wrong cause ('a savepoint was put back …') the two stale-slot messages name for a copy; (vi) R6: splitThrough's `row` refusing `shape` — M0-a-04; (vii) a kernel-side invariant for the converse oracle (R10) — M0-a-14's validator; (viii) R8: whether a `shape` row makes a vertex editable (`VertexSig`) — a notes row for M2a. A seat that meets one of these REPORTS it under its queue name and builds nothing for it. THE RESTARTS (a fact of this platform on 2026-11-12 / 13: a container restarts about every two hours whether or not background tasks are live; /home/user/maps-scratch survives, every process dies, /tmp does not survive): every run over ten minutes is a STEP OF A RE-ENTRANT CHAIN under /home/user/maps-scratch/waves/ — its log and its exit-code file beside it, and for a run of many parts one exit-code file per part, so that a seat that comes back after a restart skips what is finished: the census one file per seed or family; RELATED@1000 IN CHUNKS — collect RELATED's own file list once (`vitest related --run` with the JSON reporter and a test-name filter that matches nothing, e.g. -t '^__no_such_test__$'), split it by 12 files, run each chunk with `vitest run --passWithNoTests` at PLAT_FUZZ_RUNS=1000 under ONE recorded PLAT_FUZZ_SEED, each chunk's JSON report and exit code beside it, the totals summed from the JSON reports (a file that registers no test at 1 000 runs is named); NEAR one run per project; each mutant its own exit-code file. A CHECKPOINT line names the chain's directory and its next unfinished step at least every twenty minutes of the seat's own work. No timing bar is judged on these machines.
